scope: All swarm agents, applied independently to each verified account and weekly quota pool.
rules: Below 15 percent weekly remaining: admit no new autonomous work, expansion, retries, or successor jobs. Checkpoint existing work and terminate safely.
At or below 10 percent weekly remaining: no autonomous model calls or dispatch against that pool. The final 10 percent is reserved for the operator and manual work.
Do not use the reserve to finish a task. Begin wrap-up early enough to preserve it; publish partial results and a restart pointer when necessary.

Unknown, stale, or unbound quota does not authorize new autonomous work on a metered weekly pool. A pool with no weekly quota must be explicitly classified as such and retain its other resource and spend caps.
Keep quota pools distinct. Codex telemetry does not establish ChatGPT voice, ordinary chat, Kimi, or local inference capacity.
Preserve existing stricter stops and caps. No automatic reset redemption, cap increase, purchase, or paid fallback.
Resume after a verified quota reset or explicit operator authorization consistent with the reserved manual budget.
